issue.description:
Publishing is automatic since R026, but assembling the git commit is still manual and is a reliable footgun. Two ways it goes wrong, both hit on 2026-09-02:

1. 'git commit <paths>' stages tracked modifications but NOT new untracked files. Committing .beads/checkpoint by pathspec silently omitted a freshly written object, and NEEDLE's checkpoint-verification hook rejected it:
     checkpoint-publish: error: staged current.json root is missing from the index:
     objects/0a82a10efc9dcd70eb7e89305809130356e101910f6d6bfd114b7a1fc257c66e.jsonl
   Without that hook the commit would have recorded a checkpoint referencing an object that was not in the tree.

2. Compaction renames objects, so a hand-written pathspec is stale the moment it is typed. In one commit the same operation appeared as two R099 renames plus an untracked directory.

bead-rs already computes the exact consistent set -- sync status names the verified root. Have it stage that set after a successful publish. Staging is idempotent, mutates no history, needs no branch policy, and removes this entire error class; whoever commits next picks up a correct fileset.

Deliberately NOT committing -- see the auto-commit bead for why that is the wrong layer.

The obvious objection is polluting a concurrent worker's index on a shared checkout. It inverts here: checkpoint files are shared state that is supposed to be committed, so being swept into another worker's commit is the correct outcome for them, unlike a source file being swept (which is the real hazard, and is a separate concern).
issue.title: Stage the verified checkpoint fileset automatically after publishing it

Gate circuit repaired — root cause was the checkpoint-churn race, not a broken command. The default_rust gate (payload: cargo check --all-targets --quiet, per 'needle gates --workspace', state [Clean]) is wrapped by the HEAD-stability check ('git verify command-gate subject'): capture workspace HEAD, verify in a git-archive extraction, re-check HEAD. Every bead publication auto-stages .beads/checkpoint changes and the needle-checkpoint-unwedge-beadrs.timer (10s cadence) lands them as 1-2 commits, so any multi-minute verification window caught a HEAD move; each failed attempt's own error-recording publication then churned HEAD for the next attempt — a self-sustaining loop that reached 22 consecutive errors and degraded the workspace. miroir showed the identical circuit (4 consecutive errors) the same night, confirming this is fleet-wide churn racing, not a bead-rs repo defect; no source change was needed (verification-only outcome). Repairs applied: (1) ~/.git-credentials had flipped root-owned again (the known recurring fault), killing push auth — chowned back to coding:users, ls-remote and push verified; this had also let 13 churn commits pile up unpushed; (2) settled all pending checkpoint residue deterministically — bead sync commit landed 7e8a415, superseded-object deletions landed as 0ca80b7 and d57737f — tree now clean and HEAD stable, so the next gate run has nothing moving under it; (3) pushed 039e71a..d57737f to origin/main, git rev-list origin/main..HEAD is empty. Acceptance evidence, all in a clean git-archive extraction of HEAD (dir /var/tmp/beadrs-0af5e7ff-verify-TLdyie, removed after success): gate payload cargo check --all-targets --quiet ran with no errors, exit 0; repo definition of done scripts/definition-of-done.sh --fast printed 'PASS: fmt + test', exit 0. Verification ran at extraction of 0ca80b7; the only later commits (7279d52, d57737f) touch .beads/checkpoint exclusively — zero source delta. The degraded flag clears automatically on the next successful gate run, which now executes against a quiet, settled, fully-pushed workspace. issue.description:
## Gate Execution Error

The gate command `git verify command-gate subject` failed to execute in workspace `/home/coding/bead-rs`.

### Error Details
- **Gate**: default_rust
- **Command**: `git verify command-gate subject`
- **Reason**: workspace HEAD changed from captured revision 523e8f65324cff0e338ce63bf221b0cf4af9cb21 to a88bb4806255fa79ecebfe41996b1141f1595be6 while verification ran
- **Consecutive errors**: 6

### Impact
This workspace is now **degraded**. Pluck and Explore strands will skip it for ordinary dispatch.
The workspace remains claimable for manual intervention or fixing this specific gate.

### Resolution
Fix the gate command (e.g., install missing dependency, correct path, resolve permissions) 
and the workspace will be automatically restored on the next successful gate run.

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Gate command runs successfully
- [ ] No stderr errors (ENOENT, EACCES, timeout)
- [ ] Exit code is 0

### Verification
The gate command will be re-run on the next dispatch attempt. A successful run will:
- Clear the degraded state
- Close this bead automatically
- Restore normal workspace operation
issue.notes: Root cause identified: this is NOT a broken dependency or path — it is the checkpoint-churn race documented in project memory. The needle gate (default_rust = cargo check --all-targets --quiet, wrapped in the HEAD-stability check 'git verify command-gate subject') captures workspace HEAD, verifies in a git-archive extraction, then re-checks HEAD. Meanwhile every bead publication in this workspace auto-stages .beads/checkpoint changes, and the needle-checkpoint-unwedge-beadrs.timer (10s cadence) lands them as 1-2 commits. Gate-health state showed 22 consecutive HEAD-changed errors; each failed attempt's own error-recording publication then moved HEAD for the next attempt — a self-sustaining circuit. miroir shows the identical circuit (4 consecutive errors), confirming it is fleet-wide churn racing, not a bead-rs repo defect. Fixes applied this attempt: (1) ~/.git-credentials had flipped root:root again (the known recurring fault) killing push auth — chowned back to coding:users, git ls-remote and push verified working; (2) settled pending checkpoint residue: bead sync commit landed 7e8a415 and the superseded-object deletion landed as 0ca80b7 — workspace HEAD stable and tree clean, so the next gate run has nothing churning under it; (3) pushed 039e71a..0ca80b7 to origin/main (13 unpushed churn commits had accumulated because of the credential fault). No source changes needed or made. Verification of the gate payload runs in a clean extraction of HEAD 0ca80b7.
